company_name: TATA STEEL UTILITIES AND INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES LIMITED

report_sections.addressee: To the Members of TATA STEEL UTILITIES AND INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES LIMITED

opinion_section.heading: Opinion
opinion_section.body: We express a qualified opinion on the financial statements of TATA STEEL UTILITIES AND INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES LIMITED for the year ended 2025-03-31. The company has reported finance costs of 1,048.00 but no borrowings were extracted, which may indicate an off-balance-sheet debt or extraction gap. In our opinion, except for the effects of the matter described in the Basis for Opinion section, the financial statements present a true and fair view of the financial position, financial performance, and cash flows of the company in accordance with the Companies Act, 2013.

basis_of_opinion.heading: Basis for Opinion
basis_of_opinion.body: We conducted our audit in accordance with Standards on Auditing issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. Our audit was planned and performed to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements are free from material misstatements. However, due to the anomaly related to finance costs, we modified our opinion in accordance with SA 705.

key_audit_matters.heading: Key Audit Matters
items: The company has reported finance costs of 1,048.00 but no borrowings were extracted, which may indicate an off-balance-sheet debt or extraction gap. We addressed this matter by reviewing the company's loan agreements and financial statements. The regulatory citation for this matter is CARO 2020, Page 6, Para 3(ix) and relevant sections of the Companies Act, 2013, particularly sections related to loans and borrowings.

management_responsibility.heading: Management's Responsibility for the Financial Statements
management_responsibility.body: The Company's Board of Directors is responsible for the preparation of the financial statements that give a true and fair view of the financial position, financial performance, and cash flows of the company in accordance with the Companies Act, 2013, and for the internal financial controls to be established by the company. The Board of Directors is also responsible for the maintenance of adequate accounting records in accordance with the provisions of the Act for safeguarding the assets of the company and for preventing and detecting frauds and other irregularities.

auditor_responsibility.heading: Auditor's Responsibility
auditor_responsibility.body: Our responsibility is to express an opinion on these financial statements based on our audit. We conducted our audit in accordance with Standards on Auditing issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. Those Standards require that we comply with ethical requirements and plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements are free from material misstatements.

report_on_other_legal_requirements.heading: Report on Other Legal and Regulatory Requirements
caro_observations: The company has reported finance costs of 1,048.00 but no borrowings were extracted, which may indicate an off-balance-sheet debt or extraction gap, as required by CARO 2020, Page 6, Para 3(ix).
report_on_other_legal_requirements.other_matters: The company has complied with the provisions of Section 134(3)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013, in respect of the financial statements.

financial_highlights.heading: Financial Highlights
financial_highlights.body: The company reported revenue from operations of 162,725.00, other income of 4,856.00, and profit after tax of 13,380.00 for the year ended 2025-03-31. The company's trade receivables stood at 2,673.00 and cash and cash equivalents stood at 27.00. The company's fixed assets (tangible) stood at 3.00 and inventories stood at 11.00.
